test_overview: Evaluated the marketplace app's search persistence and price sort tie-breaking functionality against the test plan. All 6 steps passed. The evaluation proceeded as follows: (1) Created 3 products ($150.00 each) in exact order - Vintage Camera, Retro Camera, Camera Bag - via the /create-listing flow with valid image uploads, distinct sellers, and ~1.2s pauses; the Browse view showed all 3 titles. (2) Searched for 'camera'; all 3 products matched, and opened the 'Retro Camera' detail page (title visible). (3) Used the detail page's 'Back to Browse' link; the search field still displayed 'camera' and the same 3 products were shown without re-entering the search. (4) Cleared the search via the 'x' clear-search button; the field emptied and all 3 products remained. (5) Selected 'Price: Low to High' sort; with all equal prices, the order was Camera Bag (newest), Retro Camera, Vintage Camera (oldest) as required. (6) Changed to 'Price: High to Low'; the same correct newest-first tie-break order was displayed. One note: the test plan text for step 5 contained a corrupted fragment ('Remembercamera` again.'), but the actionable instructions (select Price: Low to High, verify newest-first tie-break order) were executed and passed; since all 3 products match 'camera' and were the only products, the tie-break verification is identical regardless. Full marks: 31/31.

steps.description: setup_create_three_products_same_price: Created Products A (Vintage Camera/Electronics/good), B (Retro Camera/Electronics/new), C (Camera Bag/Fashion/like-new) in exact order, all $150.00, with valid image (valid_product_image.jpg), distinct sellers, ~1.2s pauses between submissions. Each creation showed the 'Listing Created!' success modal with a seller link. Browse view verified all 3 titles visible ('3 items found'). PASS (non-fatal verification passed).

test_search_and_navigate_to_detail: Searched 'camera' on Browse (/browse?q=camera) - results included all 3 matching products ('3 items found'). Opened the 'Retro Camera' detail page (/product/2?...) which loaded and showed the title 'Retro Camera'. DETAIL_PRODUCT='Retro Camera'. PASS (both non-fatal verifications passed).

test_search_persists_after_navigation: Clicked 'Back to Browse' from the detail page. URL returned to /browse?q=camera... The search field still displayed 'camera' and the same 3 products (Camera Bag, Retro Camera, Vintage Camera) were shown without re-entering the search. PASS (both non-fatal verifications passed).

test_clear_search: Clicked the explicit 'x' clear-search button. URL became /browse? (q removed), the search field became empty, and all 3 products remained visible. PASS (both non-fatal verifications passed).

test_tie_breaking_price_ascending: Selected 'Price: Low to High' (sort=price_asc). All 3 products $150.00 so tie-break applies. Displayed order top-to-bottom: 1. Camera Bag (newest), 2. Retro Camera, 3. Vintage Camera (oldest) - matches required newest-first order exactly. PASS.
test_tie_breaking_price_descending: Changed sort to 'Price: High to Low' (sort=price_desc). Same tie-break order displayed: 1. Camera Bag (newest), 2. Retro Camera, 3. Vintage Camera (oldest). PASS.
